integration_decision.name: TWO_STAGE_CONCURRENCY_PROOF_NO_VACUOUS_PASS
integration_decision.finding: Re-read exact runner/storage/output/handoff: output publication is three individually atomic JSON replacements, not a generation-wide transaction; archive admission reads/checks then appends without visible process lock. Preserve pinned P0/P1 test-only overlays. Classify a P0 negative control as RED only if B writes latest before A is released and final three-file stamps disagree; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Classify P1 same-ID race as RED only with witnessed concurrent admission and duplicate/integrity failure; a passing run without overlap is NOT sufficient proof of cross-process safety. After any separately authorized Gemini-only fix, allow serialization, require non-skipped P0/P1 GREEN with both writers/processes completed and integrity checks. No unexecuted PASS asserted.
